title: Add branch-level release auth probe and wire Tactus to platform-ci test ref

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Preparing branch-safe release auth validation: point reusable workflow call at platform-ci feature ref and add workflow_dispatch probe that runs git push --dry-run against main using anthusbot token path.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Implemented on branch fix/release-workflow: (1) release.yml now consumes AnthusAI/platform-ci/.github/workflows/semantic-release-reusable.yml@feature/dry-semantic-release; (2) added .github/workflows/release-auth-probe.yml workflow_dispatch job to validate anthusbot push auth using git push --dry-run origin HEAD:main.
